description: A single contributor's guess at where a historical photo was taken. Placeholder NSID — replace 'place.yesterdays' with a domain you control before writing to production.

subject.description: Which photo, by stable external archive id. No central catalog.

archive.description: Registry key for the source archive, e.g. 'loc', 'lva', 'valentine', or 'sample'.

itemId.description: Stable identifier for the item WITHIN that archive.

point.description: A sharp, high-precision vote: it was HERE.

lat.description: Decimal degrees WGS84 as a string (lexicon has no float type).

lng.description: Decimal degrees WGS84 as a string.

bearingDeg.description: Optional camera facing, degrees clockwise from true north.

circle.description: A soft constraint: somewhere around here.

lat.description: Center latitude, decimal degrees WGS84 as a string.

lng.description: Center longitude, decimal degrees WGS84 as a string.
